attributes.name: Slimy Fiend
attributes.powers:
The Slimy Fiend is immune to the Acid and Poison traits. Before you act, succeed at an Arcane or Divine 17 check or you may not play spells that have the Attack trait.

After you act, if the check to defeat did not have the Attack or Ranged trait, the Slimy Fiend deals 1d4+1 Acid damage to you.
